response.original_title: [Quick™GUIDe] How do I change my cabin on a Marella Cruises
response.overview: Yes, +1-866 829-1280(US) you can change your cabin on Marella Cruises. You can switch to an available cabin in the same category, request an upgrade, +1-866 829-1280(US) or submit a bid for a higher state cabin tier. You cannot easily switch cabins online yourself without canceling and re-booking. You can upgrade or switch Cabins by calling Marella Cruises at +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK), using their website, or contacting your travel agent. Last-minute changes +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) on the day of sailing are generally not accommodated.
